assessment.summary: Zeliq (founded 2023, Paris) is an AI-powered B2B sales prospecting and outreach platform that just raised a €7M seed extension (total ~€21M/$21-23M raised) led by The Moon Venture, and is launching an AI agent called Zelia. It's a legitimate, growing SaaS company, but it's a France-headquartered player in a very crowded sales-tech category, which tempers the fit for a US-based engineer prioritizing technical depth and market novelty.
assessment.product: An all-in-one B2B sales platform: prospect database search, contact/email/phone enrichment, and multichannel (email/LinkedIn/phone) outreach sequencing, now adding an AI agent (Zelia) that can search for, enrich, and contact prospects autonomously based on rep instructions.
assessment.team: Founded 2023 by Dorian Ciavarella (CEO, previously co-founder/CEO of Hivency, acquired by Skeepers/PSG), Guillaume Cruz (COO, ex-Accenture/EY, former CFO at two VC-backed French startups), and Victor Lennel (CTO). Reported team size roughly 21-100 (one source: ~30 employees across 40+ countries).
assessment.funding: €7M seed extension announced 2026-09-22, led by The Moon Venture, with Julien Jean (JJCapinvest) and Sylvestre Blavet (Freelance.com) participating alongside existing investors Ora Global and Cleo Ventures plus angels/family offices. Prior rounds: ~€5-5.8M pre-seed (May 2023, led by Resonance) and ~€6.9M seed (June 2024). Total raised to date is reported around €21M (~$21-23M).
redFlags: Positioning ('agentic revenue workspace') leans on current AI-agent hype language in a category where many competitors make similar claims.
No US HQ or clearly stated US remote-hiring policy found, despite a New York mailing address on some filings that appears to be an administrative/virtual address rather than an operating office.
greenFlags: Demonstrated product traction: user base grew 2,000 → 20,000 and revenue tripled ahead of this round.
Zelia AI agent shipped after over a year of development and tens of thousands of user tests, suggesting more than a superficial LLM wrapper.
Repeat-founder CEO with a prior successful exit (Hivency → Skeepers/PSG), and multiple institutional/angel investors across three rounds signal credibility.
Round size (€7M) fits comfortably within the user's preferred $2M-$150M range.
